project.name: QH :: Module :: Party :: 01 Reference Data
project.description: Reference/lookup catalogs and the geographic hierarchy: the full REF_COUNTRY -> REF_PROVINCE -> REF_COUNTY/REF_CITY -> REF_DISTRICT chain plus GEOGRAPHIC_LOCATION, and every REF_* classification catalog used by the core Party tables (gender, marital status, role type, verification status, contact type, group type, audit action, etc. - uniform code/title_fa/ description_fa/display_order/is_active shape). No dependency on any other business module.
